request.spec:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each sheet now has its own "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. `bin/e2e` passes.

I also called the API directly to check the server side:
- A new sheet starts on the real date (2026-10-22).
- An impossible date like `2024-02-30` is refused with an error and nothing is saved.
- Loading the sheet again, including as another user, keeps the date that was set.

The app doesn't yet have anything else that depends on the date, so nothing existing needed switching over to the sheet's today. For later features I added `useSheetToday(sheetId)` on the front end and `SheetRepository.today(id)` on the server, so they can read the sheet's date instead of the real clock. The only place the app reads the real clock is when a sheet is first created, to set its starting date.

**What changed:**
- **Stored data:** a new `V2__sheet_today.sql` adds a `today` column to the sheet table (existing sheets get their creation date). Sheet loading now only creates the row if it's missing. Before, it overwrote the existing row, which would have reset today every time a sheet was reloaded.
- **Server:** loading a sheet now returns its `today`. There are two new endpoints:
  - `GET /api/sheets/{sheetId}` reads a sheet, and returns 404 for an id that was never loaded.
  - `PUT /api/sheets/{sheetId}/today` changes the date. It accepts only real `yyyy-mm-dd` dates and refuses unknown sheets.
- **Front end:** `features/sheet/sheet.ts` holds the sheet query and the `useSheetToday` hook. `features/sheet/today.slot.tsx` shows the date (`sheet-today`), the input (`sheet-today-input`), the save button (`sheet-today-save`) and the error message (`sheet-error`), which clears when the input is edited or the form is submitted again.

Changing today doesn't write an audit record: the request didn't ask for one and the test doesn't expect one, so I didn't invent a format.
